sentences.en: You cannot take a picture in the theater without permission.
sentences.zh: 未经允许你不能在剧院里拍照。

sentences.en: Each time I see this picture, I remember my father.
sentences.zh: 每次看到这张照片我都会想起我的父亲。

sentences.en: Come closer and have a good look at this picture.
sentences.zh: 走近点，好好看看这张照片。

senses.zh: 图画，肖像；照片 - (生动的)描述，写照 - 影片；电影；画面 - 美景，景色 - 情况，事态，局面 -
